reply_text:
Gideon, in this channel the first report is your message at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, which says the gate kiosks were offline at the Hartford plant. That is the earliest message here, so if the report went out somewhere else first, I can't see it from this room.

The only guard detail in the channel is from that same 10:42 message: the guard was "writing trailer numbers on a clipboard." Nothing else in the channel describes the guard's activity until later. Mateo's 11:03 message says the guard checked in trailer 8836 once kiosk 1 was back and dispatch could see it. Your 11:08 message says both lanes were working as of 11:07.
